batting.name: Y Venugopal Rao
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b MF Maharoof

batting.name: A Symonds
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b MF Maharoof

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c GD McGrath b R Bhatia

batting.name: AS Yadav
batting.dismissal: c G Gambhir b VY Mahesh

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b RP Singh

balls.text: slower ball, good length outside off, Vaas makes room and drives past point to the sweeper and scampers back for the second

oh good grief, its a massive no ball and a massive shot! Yo Mahesh bowls the ball well over a beamer length, up near Vaas' head even after he dances down the track, and what follows is an extraordinary swat over cover-point for six! Wow!
makes room to leg and slashes in the air and the ball is just wide of McGrath at short cover, who dives but cannot catch on, Malik does the cleaning up in the deep
low full toss on the stumps, driven in the air down to long-on for one
slower ball outside off, a mistimed chop to point for a quick single
it goes a bit quite as Yadav gets under a shortish one and mistimes the flat-batted attempt to Gambhir in the covers, who doesn't have to do much
full toss outside leg stump, Vaas mistimes the slog and the ball runs to backward point, they scamper a quick leg-bye
oh thats poor stuff from Delhi, as Yadav drives the ball hard down to long-off, where Gambhir misfields and allows the ball to run away off his palms
comes forward and chips a slow ball through midwicket
well held out on the ropes, as Sharma walks down and hammers the low full toss off the toe end of the bat out to McGrath at deep midwicket
full outside off, Yadav opens the face and dabs a single for one
another slow delivery, but Yadav leans back and hammers it over the bowler's head ... they are piling on the runs now!

Yadav slogs the slower delivery up into the air over mid-off, extra cover is nowhere in the picture, long-off runs in and cannot judge it well and the ball drops in front of him, Yadav comes back for the second
drilled again, Maharoof gets a hand on it to take some pace but parries the ball down to long-off and thats a 26-run over .. woof!
wow, take a bow, Sharma! Just a step to leg and the deadest of straight drives, just clubbed between the stumps and the nonstriker and he doesn't even move
very, very well played, Sharma! He walks right across his stumps, well outside off stump, and produces an excellent paddle to fine leg
and again, Sharma makes room and creams this flat over the covers, another stunning shot and that gets the crowd into a tizzy

and that bigger and better, and raises a superb half-century! Sharma! Clears the front leg, waits for the ball to come, and slams the slower ball for a massive hit over deep midwicket ... thats a huge hit
but Sharma's not giving up! Thats his third six, slogged handsomely over midwicket for a flat shot
slower ball, nearly a yorker and Yadav just manages to get bat on it
shorter one, he gets into position and hits out to McGrath at deep midwicket on the bounce
just over the ropes! Sharma makes room and drills this one dead straight and the ball just cross the ropes
change of pace, back of a length, dabbed to backward point
pushes coming forward and gets a single down to long-off

poor call there! Full on the stumps, Bangar pushes to cover and sets off but Sharma sells him down the river as he sees Tiwary coming in, Bangar is so far down that he has no chance of getting back and Karthik collects the flat throw
swivels around and goes for pull, cramped, and ends up inside-edging at his feet and Asif runs in to field it himself
short on the stumps, stays low and Bangar swats it to square leg
dances down again and this time inside-edges to short fine leg
shot, son! Asif pitches on a length, Sharma uses the feet superbly and hammers that over long-on for a big six
this one's a tad shorter and nips into Bangar's midriff, he again looks to tuck it away but runs a quick leg-bye to point
bang on the money, middle and off, he looks to nudge it away but ends up playing it back to Asif
comes well forward and opens the face to collect a single to third man
looks to make room, gets a full toss, and can only drive to mid-on
gets down, reaches out and slogs along the ground to midwicket
strides well forward and dabs the slower ball to gully for one more
full toss on the stumps, pulled out to deep midwicket, just one but
short of a length on the stumps, gets up and turns it to midwicket
change of pace, Bangar gets well forward and drives one to extra cover
there's a shot! Sharma makes room and drills the fuller one over extra cover
this one stops on him but he tips it to point for a smart single
good shot, a firm on-drive to a fuller one gets him one to long-on
short in length and he hops up, playing it down past gully for one to McGrath at third man
comes down and just jams the bat down in time, the ball evades leg stump and  he picks up a single to short fine leg
slower one outside off, he mistimes the shot and Karthik fields
comes forward, waits, and opens the face to play a nice guide again
on off stump, pushed at and he does well to keep it down to third man
pushes at one moving late, misses, and Karthik collects smoothly
gets forward and drives a good-looking shot into the covers

and he strikes first ball, would you believe? Bhatia pitches on about middle and leg, Afridi gets across to try and scoop it away to fine leg, misses, and umpire Saheba lifts up the finger as it looks like it would have taken out leg stump .. a good call, as I've just seen replays.
innovative shot, back leg up and a flat-batted paddle past midwicket
short on off stump, Sharma gets up and plays it down with good control into the gap at square leg for another easy single
fuller in length, not quite a yorker, and Afridi whips it to midwicket
back of a length on off stump, tucked to midwicket for a quick single
this one kicks off, swings, and beats Sharma as he chases it
thats a cheeky shot, the paddle to the slower delivery, looks to be heading for for before Yo Mahesh comes sliding across the turf, well stopped
fuller and straighter, Sharma gets the front foot forward and plays across the pad, just working it to midwicket for a quick single
edged and it just evades a leaping Karthik, flinging himself to his right after Sharma flashes ever so hard at the away-swinger
fuller one is clipped just over McGrath at mid-on and the ball runs away
comes in off a length and Sharma guides it towards gully this time
good length on middle and off, patted back and Yo Mahesh cuts it off
lovely ball, pitching on a length, sucking him forward and the away movement gets him pushing and feeling, that narrowly missed taking the edge
back of a length and he runs that to backward point to end the over

its all happening! Afridi first takes his eyes off the short ball as he goes pulling, the ball parries off his chest and shoulder and drops at his feet, Sharma harries down with a cheeky run on his mind but gets sold down the river, Maharoof collects and has all the time to throw the ball back to the other end, but throws it past Sehwag, all ready to gather the ball ... madness!
bounced over leg stump as he thinks about coming forward
short of a length and he gets back to run the ball to backward point
edged and taken and thats a big wicket for Maharoof! Symonds doesn't move his feet much as he goes fishing to one back of a length and Karthik dives to his right to pluck a good low catch
again he uses his preferred steer off the back foot through gully
thats a wide, as he bowls it very short outside off stump and Sharma pulls out of his pull, pirouetting in his crease as the ball moves well away
waits and this time connects with his steer down to third man
tries to dab it fine but mistimes the shot and Karthik dives well to stop
thats a good length and Symonds, waiting on the back foot, comes forward to drive it wide of Yo Mahesh down to deep mid-off
comes forward and runs the wide one down to third man for one
wide again but Sharma misses as he tries to dab it late and fine, undone by the bit of bounce and no footwork
short and wide and he smashes that over the fingertips of point with a firm slap, just getting tall on going at it very hard, top shot from Sharma
now who didn't see this coming! A frustrated Venu makes room and drives inside-out over cover but straight down Dhawan's throat out on the boundary, and he didn't have to move a bit
now he connects, drilling it down the track and Maharoof does well to get a finger on that brute of a shot
short one comes into him and he takes his eyes off it, just swatting at it and missing all ends up
straighter one and Venu heaves across the length, clearly looking at midwicket, but the cross-batted shot doesn't work for him again
back of a length, jags in, Symonds gets tall and taps it down to point with soft hands, well played
slow and wide, 98ks,Venu waits and guides it to backward point
straight on the stumps and he works it to midwicket
fuller in length, slower ball too, Symonds drives it back to McGrath along the ground and he stick out his right foot to stop the ball
the response is a bouncer over off, which Symonds ducks under
bang, thats four more! Symonds skips down, creating the room, and slams his former Australian team-mate over the covers for a one-bounce four
shot! Too short and he pulls that with power from outside off stump into the gap at midwicket, making sure to roll the wrists
oh thats lucky, Venu pulling a short one on the stumps and looking on as the ball balloons up over midwicket and drops safely
shorter one just outside off, Symonds gets very tall to play it down to point and that ends a top over from Asif
off the mark with a back-foot slap just wide of backward point, no seam movement that time, and McGrath runs around from third man to slide and cut it off, good job from the veteran
hits that spot again and Symonds shoulders arms this time
beaten off the back foot, standing and driving but the extra carry does it
back of a length and seaming away, Symonds leaves it be

gone through him! Asif strikes again, pitching a tad fuller just outside off stump and bringing it into to a leaden-footed Laxman, who plays all over it with his ugly attempt of a flick, the thinnest of inside-edges splaying the stumps
tidy end to the over, McGrath pitching on a length and Venu pushing the ball off the front foot to Tiwary at backward point
a better shot, this time struck off the front foot but straight to point
and he's turned right around, closing his eyes and eyeing Banjara Hills, swiping very ungainly and missing the ball by yards
lovely agricultural slog across the line, resulting in a genuine french-cut which evades the wicketkeeper and runs down to fine leg
pulls from outside off stump but mistimes it into the ground, its just wide of the sluggish midwicket fielder and the batsmen cross for a couple
a bit outside off stump and Laxman square-drives well, but this time Tiwary gets his hands on it and saves runs
beaten again, this time getting the ball to jump up off a short length and whiz past the bat as Venu doesn't move his feet and flashes
whoah there, cowboy, where are you going? Asif invites the drive and Venu chases it with zero footwork, missing by a country mile
gets some width and steers it to backward point, where Manoj Tiwary absolutely makes a mess of it, eyes off the ball and allowing Laxman to get off the mark
tidy, tidy, tidy .. Laxman can only defend to point again, riveting stuff
back of a length and Laxman defends to backward point, before inching forward and sending Venu back ... he's wearing a black bandanna, Laxman. Cool.
hits a good length and Laxman - whats this? - unleashes a most copybook front-foot defensive which Asif retrieves with little fuss
biffed over his head, just getting to the pitch and teeing off very hard, a firm stroke gives the crowd something to cheer about, as McGrath shakes his head and goes to his place in the field
straighter one, tucked to midwicket and sets off, Laxman is rooted to his crease and waves him back and Venu has to hurry and get back and survives as Dhawan  is late to release the ball
comes forward to play at it again but then holds back on the shot
beaten by the movement and carry, Venu feeling for the ball outside off stump and  almost getting squared up by the late swing from Pigeon
firm, flowing cover-drive which Malik half-stops in the covers
again, on the dime and getting the ball to shave past Venu's tame push off thef front foot, just to late in reading the movement

and he's gone! A tame end, Gilchrist half-poking at one just outside off stump with no footwork, and looks on as the inside-edge is dragged back onto his stumps, he was trying to leave the ball but didn't do so well at all, first strike to Asif and the Chargers
again a touch too straight and Gilchrist tries another pick-up shot off the pads, this time raising his head early and the ball pops up over mid-on to drop safely in no-man's land
tidier stuff, on a length on middle and off and Gilchrist tucks it to midwicket, Venu scampers down and gets send back, rightfully
hello! On the pads and Gilchrist flicks that disdainfully over deep square leg with an effortless, monster of a hit for half a dozen
back of a length on off stump and he pokes it to point off the back foot
top start, just back of a length and angled across Gilchrist, who leaves
closer to the stumps and he drives well to Maharoof at extra cover
fuller length outside off stump, short of a real tempting length, the late away-swing  gets Venu leaving it be
good stuff, pitching on off stump and shaping away, Venu comes onto the front foot hesitantly and defends to point, sending Gilchrist back
runs off the pads as McGrath pitches full on the pads and Gilchrist, attempting a flick, scampers a leg-bye to midwicket
again he hits that spot outside off and Gilchrist leaves it alone
good start from Pigeon, bowling from around  the stumps with two slips, as he lands in on the dime and swings it in, for Gilchrist to leave it be
and a wide seals the win, sliding down leg stump and that a nine-wicket thumping for the Delhi Daredevils, their second in a row

bye bye! Sehwag is unstoppable, just standing his ground and sending Symonds rows back over long-on, and thats a 30-run over which reads like someone's cell number ... 4 6 4 6 4 6 ... and the scores are tied!
oh this is like X-box cricket! Four more, pulled over midwicket, what an over!
good grief, now he's smashed him over cover! Sehwag is on a roll, just stepping aside and carving the ball for another flat six
banged in short, he gets up on one leg and rolls the wrists, pulling into the ground behind square leg and the sweeper running around, Ojha, dives and lets the ball go away
flat six, as Sehwag just picks the length up and carries through with a pull over square leg, lovely stuff
hooooooooooo! Sehwag wants to fly out of Hyderabad as soon as possible, again clearing the front leg and slamming Symonds over extra cover
tossed up on leg stump, Dhawan waits and tucks it to midwicket
skips down and connects this time, driving to mid-on for one
oh thats silly from Gilchrist, who misses the simplest of stumpings after Sehwag is sucked down the track, misses by miles, the ball hits the helmet and runs away
spins away but he gets over it and dabs it to point for one
rubbish bowling, two feet outside leg stump, arm ball gone wrong
spins across Sehwag, who steers it to short third man
bad ball, slipping down leg stump, Gilchrist cant get there
steps miles outside leg stump and slashes the short one to long-off
beaten again as he pushes at this one with no footwork, well bowled
cracked off the back foot, a lovely cut through the gap at point
a loud shout, as Dhawan misses pulling a shorter one that pitches just outside leg stump and looks to be carrying on high, a good call that time
beaten this time as he tries to be cute and dab it fine
short again and Dhawan cuts, but this time the fielder gets to it
too short outside off stump and Sehwag cracks it to backward point
better stuff, on the stumps and squaring him up, defended uneasily
too short and Dhawan cuts this past point for an easy couple runs
sensibly done, just shuffling and tucking off the pads for one
he's going the distance, just clearing the front leg and creaming Afridi over extra cover for another big six
short and flat, Sehwag backs away and cuts hard to Sharma at point, who allows the ball through his grasp
spins across and he cuts past backward point for a single
wow, he's taking Bangar to the dhobi-ghaat! Gets one on the pads and swats it over midwicket for a flat, one-bounce four, fun to watch, and a 27-ball fifty, well done Sehwag
even better! Sehwag sends this one rows back, just stepping across and picking the shorter one over deep square leg again, thats a big hit
shot! Sehwag sees the full toss slide down leg stump and pulls it effortlessly over deep backward square leg for a flat six
low, low full toss on off stump and Sehwag smears it though backward point, and the outfield is so fast that third man cannot get there in time
smartly done, using his feet and pushing the ball gently into the covers
swipes a fractionally shorter one, makes a mess of it, but reacts well to Dhawan's call for the single as the ball dribbles past off stump
wrong line, well down the pads, Sehwag misses, Gilchrist collects
flat this time, the orthodox legbreak, and he clips it to midwicket
flighted up outside leg, it spins in and he tucks it to square leg
touch too short but he mistimes the pull back to Afridi's left side
orthodox offspinner, Dhawan cuts past backward point for an easy two
flat outside off, not much turn as Dhawan cuts to the man at cover
flat on off stump and dug out to the man at backward point
back of a length, cramps him going for the cut and cover fields
beaten, as he drives off the front foot and misses narrowly
well played, just getting back, very upright, and pushing the shorter one through the covers and out to the sweeper
pins him back to his crease, but he plays it late and down into the gap at square leg, he wanted two but Dhawan shook him off as the sweeper came in
back of a length on off stump and pushed towards point this time
so simple, pitched up on the pads and creamed away past midwicket
shot! Nothing more than a front-foot off-drive past extra cover and mid-off, as orthodox and pleasing as they come
pitches down leg, Dhawan looks to flick but gets squared up, the ball rolls past off stump and RP swoops in to dismiss any thoughts of the single
a fraction too short and Dhawan short-arm-jabs that through midwicket
skips down, Vaas keeps it flat on leg and Sehwag clips to square leg
nips into Dhawan, who tucks it off the hips to Vaas at fine leg, who fields and returns a very tidy throw to Gilchrist
back of a length, pitches and straightens and Dhawan plays it back
short one outside off stump, sits up a lot and a wide is called for height
straighter one, he shapes to drive but gets an inside-edge to Venu at short fine leg
stays back again and Vaas changes the pace, looks like the cutter, which pitches and squares up Sehwag as he plays and misses, well bowled
hammered! Sehwag stays on the back foot and picks up the length superbly, pulling over midwicket with power
too full and straight and clipped out to the lone man out in the deep
immaculate length again, moving it in, and its poked to point
good length outside off stump, Dhawan pokes it to point
gets across off stump and pushes the ball to point, who's very sharp
nips it back from off stump, pinning Dhawan to his crease, the bat comes down in the nick of time and Sehwag is quick to call for the run past leg stump
good length delivery swings in and he pushes to backward point
edged and gone! Gambhir goes for a flashy cut outside off stump, pretty wild attempt, to a fairly average short ball and Gilchrist gleefully accepts the catch
similar line and this time he works to midwicket for a quick single
pitches outside leg stump, Sehwag stays back and tries to nudge but misses, RP starts to appeal but realises the ball was outside the line of impact
slashed hard, reaching out to the wide one, and the thick outside-edge flies wide of the slips to third man as Delhi continue to flay runs
tidy, back of a length delivery on off and its pushed back off the back foot
short again and he punches off the back foot past point for one

oh he's dropped him! Sehwag latches onto the short ball and gets undone by the extra bounce, pulling out to Ojha running across on the ropes, buts its in and out, and a boundary to boot .. very silly stuff from Hyderabad
short outside off stump and Sehwag gets onto the toes, pushing uppishly off the back foot into the gap at cover, Symonds runs after it and fires in a flat return
wrong line, and Gambhir turns off the pads to deep square leg
gets some width but can only cut the ball to the fielder at point
short of a length on the stumps, Gambhir hops and tucks to leg for one
firm square-drive, as he gets the room and dispatches the ball away with disdain, stride in, front leg cleared, bang
short of a length and he gets over it to cut out to the third man fielder
four more, as RP pitches outside Sehwag's pads and he clips it to fine leg, thats the wrong place to bowl, and how much will that reprieve cost?
thats some shot, Sehwag just whipping the attempted yorker through midwicket with a rasping flick shot, well played
third time in a row he skips down and tries to go over, but the slower ball beats him and Gilchrist collects on the awkward bounce
shuffles across and works this one past midwicket for one
gets deep and tries to dab it fine but is cramped going for the shot
comes out and drives the ball past backward point again, he's in a hurry

oh thats a good shout, Vaas pitches on about leg stump and swings it in and Sehwag, hopping to flick, catches it on the back foot, deep in his crease, but umpire Saheba shakes his head ... replays show the ball would have taken out leg stump, so Delhi get an early life
off the mark immediately, converting the ball into a full one and driving to the right of backward point for a single
